clusters.distinguishing: Addresses flaws in VLM evaluation by exposing the mirage effect—models scoring well without images—and proposes B-Clean to filter text-answerable items. This cluster is distinct in focusing on measurement validity and dataset hygiene rather than model training, representations, or application domains.

papers.title: Mirage: The Illusion of Visual Understanding
papers.one_liner: Reveals VLMs scoring high without images and introduces B-Clean to post-filter benchmarks by removing text-answerable items.
papers.summary: Авторы систематически исследовали «эффект миража» — феномен, когда мультимодальные модели генерируют детальные визуальные описания и цепочки рассуждений для изображений, которых им вообще не показывали. Для борьбы с этим предложили B-Clean — фреймворк пост-фильтрации бенчмарков, удаляющий вопросы, на которые модель может ответить, опираясь исключительно на текстовые эвристики.

clusters.name: RL for Long-Horizon Control
clusters.distinguishing: Optimizes VLMs for multi-step decision-making with reinforcement learning using asymmetric actor-critic designs and stability tricks like positive-advantage filtering. Unlike representation or benchmarking work, this targets sequential control under partial observability and long horizons.

papers.title: Odysseus: Scaling VLMs to 100+ Turn Decision-Making in Games via Reinforcement Learning
papers.one_liner: Odysseus scales VLM decision-making to 100+ steps via asymmetric actor-critic with a tiny CNN critic and positive-advantage filtering for stable long-horizon RL.
papers.summary: Авторы представили Odysseus — открытый фреймворк обучения с подкреплением (RL), который позволяет масштабировать Vision-Language Models (VLM) на задачи непрерывного принятия решений длиной более 100 шагов взаимодействия. Спарив огромную VLM-политику с крошечным CNN-критиком и применив фильтрацию положительных преимуществ (positive-advantage filtering), исследователи обходят вычислительные боттлнеки и нестабильность традиционных мультимодальных actor-critic методов.

clusters.name: Omnilingual Translation Systems
clusters.distinguishing: Scales machine translation to 1,600 languages via specialized models and embeddings (OmniSONAR), emphasizing data/benchmark creation and multilingual coverage. This differs by domain (MT) and infrastructure scaling rather than VLM internals, evaluation bias, or RL-driven decision-making.

papers.title: The Omnilingual MT Team, Belen Alastruey, Niyati Bafna, Andrea Caciolai, Kevin Heffernan, Artyom Kozhevnikov, Christophe Ropers, Eduardo Sánchez, Charles-Eric Saint-James, Ioannis Tsiamas, Chierh Cheng, Joe Chuang, Paul-Ambroise Duquenne, Mark Duppenthaler, Nate Ekberg, Cynthia Gao, Pere Lluís Huguet Cabot, João Maria Janeiro, Jean Maillard, Gabriel Mejia Gonzalez, Holger Schwenk, Edan Toledo, Arina Turkatenko, Albert Ventayol-Boada, Rashel Moritz, Alexandre Mourachko, Surya Parimi, Mary Williamson, Shireen Yates, David Dale, Marta R. Costa-jussà
papers.one_liner: Omnilingual MT scales machine translation to 1,600 languages via OmniSONAR embeddings, specialized 1–8B models, new datasets, and evaluation metrics overcoming the generation bottleneck.
papers.summary: Исследователи из FAIR представили Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT) — комплексный набор моделей, датасетов и метрик, расширяющий поддержку машинного перевода до более чем 1600 языков. Авторы предлагают два архитектурных пути: decoder-only линейку (OMT-LLaMA) на базе LLaMA 3 и encoder-decoder модель на 3B параметров (OMT-NLLB), основанную на кросс-языковом пространстве эмбеддингов OmniSONAR. Для поддержки такого масштаба команда также собрала seed-датасет MeDLEy, фреймворки для оценки BOUQuET и Met-BOUQuET, а также reference-free метрику оценки качества BLASER 3.

families.name: Reinforcement learning (general, not LLM post-training)
families.curated_description: Classical and modern RL outside the LLM-alignment context: exploration, value-based methods, actor-critic, multi-agent RL, off-policy methods, distributional RL, options/hierarchical RL, and theory of RL.
families.distinguishing: Papers in this family study reinforcement learning as a control and decision-making paradigm: learning policies and value functions from interaction with an environment, using exploration, credit assignment, bootstrapping, and off-policy/actor-critic machinery—typically in MDPs or POMDPs with task rewards. Unlike RLHF/DPO post-training for LLMs, these works optimize returns from environment feedback rather than human preference labels, and they are not tied to language models or tool-use. They span value-based, policy-gradient, distributional, hierarchical/options, and multi‑agent RL, focusing on sample efficiency, stability, and theoretical guarantees of RL algorithms. This contrasts with world models/model-based RL (which centers on learned dynamics), diffusion/autoregressive generators (which model data distributions), and multimodal/architecture families that emphasize representation or inference rather than interactive control.

clusters.name: PPO Finance with xLSTM
clusters.distinguishing: Focuses on applying PPO actor-critic with xLSTM sequence models to a financial trading environment. Distinctive elements are domain-specific design: recurrent xLSTM units for long-horizon temporal dependencies and a turbulence/risk-aware reward shaping tailored to markets, contrasting with general-purpose representation learning or extreme-depth architectures.

papers.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach to Automated Stock Trading, using xLSTM Networks
papers.one_liner: Integrates xLSTM-based actor-critic with PPO and a turbulence-penalized reward to improve DRL stock trading performance over LSTM baselines.
papers.summary: This paper introduces a novel approach to automated stock trading by integrating extended Long Short-Term Memory (xLSTM) networks with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). Addressing the limitations of traditional LSTMs, such as gradient vanishing and difficulty in capturing long-term dependencies in dynamic market environments, the study leverages xLSTM's enhanced memory structure and exponential gating within both actor and critic components of a DRL framework. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is utilized to optimize the trading strategy, balancing exploration and exploitation.

papers.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach to Automated Stock Trading, using xLSTM Networks
papers.one_liner: Integrates xLSTM into PPO actor-critic for stock trading, adding a turbulence-index reward to improve long-horizon handling and risk-adjusted returns over LSTM baselines.
papers.summary: xLSTM для улучшения глубокого обучения с подкреплением в автоматизированной торговле акциями

clusters.name: Contrastive RL Depth Scaling
clusters.distinguishing: Targets self-supervised, contrastive objectives to enable training extremely deep (up to 1000-layer) policies with architectural stabilizers like residual connections and normalization. Unlike the finance-specific PPO+xLSTM work, this line emphasizes representation learning and depth scaling for generic long-horizon goal-reaching without task-specific reward engineering.

papers.title: 1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL: Scaling Depth Can Enable New Goal-Reaching Capabilities
papers.one_liner: Shows contrastive self-supervised RL enables stable 1000-layer policy networks, unlocking improved long-horizon goal-reaching without complex reward engineering.
papers.summary: Авторы успешно масштабировали политики обучения с подкреплением (RL) со стандартных 2–5 слоёв до 1000+ слоёв. Для этого использовали самообучение (Self-Supervised Learning), а конкретно Contrastive RL, в сочетании с современным архитектурным "обвесом": Residual connections, LayerNorm и активациями Swish.

families.name: Robotics / VLA models
families.curated_description: Robot policies and vision-language-action models: RT-X / OpenVLA style policies, dexterous manipulation, ALOHA-like imitation learning, action-tokenized transformers, and embodied agents.
families.distinguishing: Papers in Robotics / VLA center on end-to-end visuomotor control that maps pixels and language goals to low-level robot actions, often via action-tokenized transformers trained from teleoperation or demonstration data (e.g., RT-X/OpenVLA/ALOHA). Unlike generic VLMs or omni-multimodal models, they ground language in executable control trajectories, with interfaces like flow-matched or discretized action heads and latency-aware inference loops. They differ from world models and model-based RL by optimizing directly for closed-loop manipulation performance rather than planning in learned dynamics, and from agents/tool-use work by producing motor commands instead of API/tool calls. Hallmarks include dexterous manipulation benchmarks, multi-embodiment transfer, and deployment-focused architectures that run on real robots.

clusters.name: Compact Efficient VLA
clusters.distinguishing: Focuses on making VLA control lightweight and deployable with small models and curated datasets. Distinguished by architectural efficiency features like a flow-matched action head, alternating attention, layer skipping, and asynchronous inference rather than large-scale reasoning or multi-agent transfer.

papers.title: SmolVLA: A vision-language-action model for affordable and efficient robotics
papers.one_liner: SmolVLA delivers 450M-parameter VLA robotics with flow-matched action head and async inference, matching much larger models using small curated datasets.
papers.summary: ? Авторы представляют SmolVLA — компактную модель «зрение-язык-действие» (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) с ~450 млн параметров, разработанную с упором на эффективность и доступность. Подход состоит из трёх элементов: 1) Облегчённая архитектура, использующая компактную основу VLM со стратегическим пропуском слоёв и эффективного «эксперта по действиям» с чередующимся вниманием и flow matching. 2) Предобучение исключительно на небольшом, тщательно отобранном наборе публичных датасетов от сообщества (менее 30 тыс. эпизодов). 3) Новый асинхронный стек для инференса, который отделяет выполнение действ

clusters.name: Embodied Reasoning and Transfer
clusters.distinguishing: Emphasizes a two-level agent with an embodied reasoning VLM guiding a VLA controller and Motion Transfer for zero-shot multi-embodiment skill sharing. Distinct from compact models by prioritizing cross-robot generalization and high-level deliberation over pure efficiency or virtual-world training.

papers.title: Gemini Robotics 1.5: Pushing the Frontier of Generalist Robots with Advanced Embodied Reasoning, Thinking, and Motion Transfer
papers.one_liner: A two-tier Gemini Robotics 1.5 system combining VLA control with an embodied reasoning VLM and Motion Transfer for zero-shot multi-robot skill sharing.
papers.summary: ? В статье представлено семейство Gemini Robotics 1.5 — пара фундаментальных моделей, предназначенных для развития робототехники общего назначения. Семейство включает: 1) Gemini Robotics 1.5 (GR 1.5) — модель «зрение-язык-действие» (VLA) для низкоуровневого управления, работающую с разными физическими воплощениями (multi-embodiment), и 2) Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 (GR-ER 1.5) — SOTA-модель для воплощённых рассуждений (Embodied Reasoning, ER) для высокоуровневого понимания и планирования. Работа предлагает три ключевых нововведения. Во-первых, новый механизм переноса движений (Motion Transfer, MT)

clusters.name: Generalist Virtual VLA
clusters.distinguishing: Targets broad competence in virtual 3D environments via finetuning a large foundation model with chain-of-thought control and open-ended self-improvement using LLM-generated tasks and rewards. Unlike the transfer-focused or compact-deployment tracks, this line centers on generality and self-curricula within simulated worlds.

papers.title: SIMA 2: A Generalist Embodied Agent for Virtual Worlds
papers.one_liner: Finetunes Gemini into a VLA agent with CoT to act in diverse 3D games and self-improve via LLM-generated tasks and rewards.
papers.summary: Представили SIMA 2 — универсальную Vision-Language-Action (VLA) модель, созданную через файнтюнинг Gemini Flash-Lite. В отличие от первой версии (https://t.me/gonzo_ML/2466), которая просто переводила инструкции в нажатия клавиш, SIMA 2 интегрирует внутренний процесс рассуждения (chain-of-thought). Это позволяет ей справляться с неоднозначными инструкциями, вести диалог и выполнять сложные многошаговые задачи в различных 3D-средах.

families.name: Omni / unified multimodal models
families.curated_description: Frontier 'omni' models that unify text, image, audio (and sometimes action) in one backbone with shared tokenizers: Gemini-style, GPT-4o, Chameleon, OmniGen, AnyGPT.
families.distinguishing: These papers build a single, shared-backbone model that natively ingests and emits multiple modalities—text, images, audio (and sometimes actions)—using unified tokenization or a common embedding space so all modalities are processed by the same transformer. Unlike VLMs or speech models that bolt modality-specific encoders/decoders onto a text core, omni models train end-to-end with cross-modal tokens flowing through one network, enabling direct interleaving (e.g., speak, see, and reason in one pass) and bidirectional generation across modalities. They differ from unified tool-use agents by being a monolithic generative model rather than an orchestrated system, and from general multimodal pretraining by insisting on one backbone that both understands and produces each modality.

clusters.name: Omni / unified multimodal models
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: AION-1: Omnimodal Foundation Model for Astronomical Sciences
papers.one_liner: AION-1 unifies 39 astronomical modalities via custom tokenizers and a transformer backbone pretrained with multimodal masking for cross-survey, cross-modal reasoning and generation.
papers.summary: ? Авторы представляют AION-1 — семейство крупных (от 300 млн до 3.1 млрд параметров) омнимодальных фундаментальных моделей для астрономии. AION-1 решает ключевую проблему гетерогенности данных, объединяя 39 различных типов данных, включая изображения, спектроскопию и скалярные метаданные, из пяти крупных астрономических обзоров в единую систему. Это достигается с помощью новой двухэтапной архитектуры: сначала набор кастомных, специфичных для каждой модальности токенизаторов преобразует зашумлённые, зависящие от приборов данные в единый дискретный словарь. Затем большой энкодер-декодер на базе

papers.title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
papers.one_liner: From-scratch unified multimodal pretraining combining token prediction and flow-matching latents with RAE and MoE to resolve modality competition and scale asymmetrically.
papers.summary: Исследователи из FAIR и NYU провели контролируемое эмпирическое исследование унифицированного мультимодального предобучения с нуля. Объединив предсказание следующего дискретного токена для текста и непрерывный flow matching для зрения в одной архитектуре, они систематически изолировали переменные, управляющие мультимодальным обучением. Они показали, что единый автоэнкодер репрезентаций (Representation Autoencoder, RAE) отлично справляется и с пониманием, и с генерацией, а архитектура Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) естественно решает проблему асимметрии скейлинга между текстом и картинками.

families.name: RAG, retrievers & embeddings
families.curated_description: Retrieval-augmented generation, embedding models (E5, BGE, GTE, NV-Embed), late-interaction retrievers (ColBERT), long-document retrieval, and retrieval evaluation.
families.distinguishing: Papers here center on augmenting models with external knowledge via retrieval, and on the representation learning that makes retrieval effective. They develop and evaluate embedding models and late‑interaction retrievers (e.g., E5/BGE/GTE/NV‑Embed, ColBERT) for dense, long‑document, and multi-hop search, and study how to route, fuse, and ground retrieved evidence in generation. Unlike reasoning/test-time compute or agent/tool papers, the core innovation is in retrieval pipelines—indexing, scoring, passage selection, and retrieval-aware decoding—not new generative architectures or RL training. This family also emphasizes retrieval metrics, dataset construction, and robustness of retrieval-augmented generation.

clusters.name: RAG, retrievers & embeddings
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Differentiable Retrieval via Continuous Latent Reasoning
papers.one_liner: CLaRa makes RAG differentiable with memory tokens and STE, aligning retrieval with generation via continuous latent reasoning.
papers.summary: Представили CLaRa — унифицированный фреймворк для RAG, который сжимает документы в непрерывные "токены памяти" (memory tokens) и оптимизирует поиск и генерацию end-to-end. Используя технику Straight-Through Estimator (STE), авторы пробрасывают градиенты от функции потерь языковой модели обратно в механизм поиска. Это заставляет ретривер выбирать документы не просто по семантической близости, а по их реальной полезности для генерации ответа.

families.name: Speech & audio models
families.curated_description: Speech recognition, TTS, neural audio codecs (Encodec, SoundStream), audio LLMs and music generation.
families.distinguishing: This family centers on models that ingest or emit raw waveforms or spectrograms, targeting tasks like ASR, TTS, neural audio coding (e.g., Encodec/SoundStream), and music or general audio generation. Unlike VLMs or omni-multimodal models, these papers optimize for time-frequency structure, latency, and perceptual audio quality (MOS, bitrates) rather than text-image grounding. They often use specialized tokenizations or codecs for continuous audio, and evaluate with speech/audio-specific metrics (WER, PESQ, STOI) and streaming constraints that don’t arise in text-only LLMs or vision models.

clusters.name: Speech & audio models
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: JEPA as a Neural Tokenizer: Learning Robust Speech Representations with Density Adaptive Attention
papers.one_liner: Uses JEPA with DAAM to learn semantic audio tokens at 2.5 Hz, then FSQ+HiFi-GAN reconstructs audio, decoupling semantics from reconstruction.
papers.summary: Авторы предложили двухэтапный фреймворк для создания речевых представлений. На первом этапе используется архитектура Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), усиленная механизмом адаптивного к плотности внимания (DAAM). Это позволяет выучивать семантические фичи через предсказание маскированных латентов в полном отрыве от задачи реконструкции волны. На втором этапе энкодер замораживают и обучают HiFi-GAN декодер с конечно-скалярным квантованием (FSQ). Итог — экстремально низкая частота кадров: всего 2.5 Гц (47.5 токенов в секунду).

families.name: Bio / genomics / protein models
families.curated_description: Models for biology: AlphaFold-2/3, ESM, RoseTTAFold, genome-scale sequence models (AlphaGenome, Evo), and ML for molecular design.
families.distinguishing: This family focuses on models trained directly on biological sequences and structures—proteins, DNA/RNA, and small molecules—to predict 3D folds, design novel sequences, infer evolutionary constraints, or model genomics signals. Unlike general VLMs or LLMs, these works pair sequence encoders (e.g., transformers with masked LM objectives or diffusion over 3D coordinates) with biophysical priors and structure-aware heads (e.g., distance/angle distributions, SE(3)-equivariant layers) and are evaluated on assays like structure accuracy, mutational effect prediction, or binding/functional screens. They uniquely integrate wet-lab data loops and molecular simulation, enabling in silico-to-in vitro design cycles that other families (reasoning, RL, or multimodal) do not target.

clusters.name: Bio / genomics / protein models
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: Closing the Resolution-Context Gap in Genomic Sequence Modeling
papers.one_liner: AlphaGenome unifies 1 Mb context with 1 bp resolution via U-Net + transformer bottleneck to predict 5,930 genomic tracks and SOTA variant effects.
papers.summary: DeepMind представила AlphaGenome — унифицированную DL-модель, которая "переваривает" 1 миллион пар оснований (1 Mb) ДНК и предсказывает 5,930 функциональных геномных треков (включая RNA-seq, сплайсинг и хроматин) с точностью до одного нуклеотида. Используя архитектуру U-Net с трансформерным "бутылочным горлышком" и дистилляцию знаний, модель достигла SOTA результатов в предсказании эффектов вариантов (VEP).

families.name: Math & formal reasoning models
families.curated_description: LLMs for math and formal proofs: AlphaProof, AlphaGeometry, Lean / Coq-coupled provers, math-specialised pretraining.
families.distinguishing: Papers in this family target symbolic mathematics and formal proof, coupling language models with theorem provers (e.g., Lean, Coq, Isabelle) or specialized search over proof states and tactics. They emphasize correctness-by-construction and verifiability—producing machine-checkable proofs, structured derivations, or solver-integrated steps—rather than natural-language reasoning alone. Distinct from generic reasoning or agent papers, these works integrate formal semantics, proof assistants, or constraint solvers, and often use math-specific pretraining corpora, self-play over proof graphs, or tactic-level RL/search to navigate formal proof spaces.

clusters.name: Math & formal reasoning models
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: Mathematical methods and human thought in the age of AI
papers.one_liner: A strategic framework for integrating AI into rigorous mathematics, emphasizing formal verification and human-AI co-working to mitigate 'odorless proofs' and epistemic risks.
papers.summary: Авторы предлагают философский и стратегический фреймворк для интеграции ИИ в математически строгие пайплайны. Описан поэтапный переход от простой помощи на периферии к полноценному коллаборативному сосуществованию человека и машины.

families.name: Autoregressive image/video/3D generation
families.curated_description: Autoregressive generative models for non-text modalities: image tokenizers (VQ-VAE/VQ-GAN/MAGVIT), AR image models (Parti, MAGI-1, ELT), AR video, and 3D generation.
families.distinguishing: This family trains discrete-token autoregressive models to generate non-text media—images, videos, and 3D—using learned tokenizers (e.g., VQ-VAE/VQ-GAN/MAGVIT) and next-token prediction over visual codebooks. Unlike diffusion/flow models, generation proceeds step-by-step via causal likelihood, not iterative denoising; unlike VLMs or omni-multimodal models, the outputs are pure visual/3D sequences rather than language-grounded reasoning. It differs from RLHF/post-training and reasoning-TTC by focusing on unconditional or conditional pixel/voxel synthesis without test-time search, and from world-models/robotics by not modeling environment dynamics or control. Key markers are discrete visual tokenization, AR decoders (transformers) for images/videos/3D, and likelihood-trained sampling with typical decoding tricks (temperature, classifier-free guidance over tokens).

clusters.name: Autoregressive image/video/3D generation
clusters.distinguishing: Too few papers (≤2) for meaningful sub-clustering; presented as a single group.

papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation
papers.one_liner: ELT uses a weight-shared recurrent transformer with ILSD to enable elastic image generation quality vs. compute, fitting entirely in on-chip memory.
papers.summary: Авторы представили Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT) — рекуррентную архитектуру для генерации изображений, которая крайне экономно расходует параметры. Модель итеративно применяет один и тот же блок трансформерных слоёв с общими весами и обучается с помощью нового алгоритма Intra-Loop Self Distillation (ILSD). Это позволяет динамически менять вычислительный бюджет (количество циклов) прямо на инференсе без переобучения.
